label: SYNTHETIC JOINT PARAMETER RECOVERY + PROFILE LIKELIHOOD
description: Joint least-squares recovery of three multiplicative scale factors (negative particle diffusivity, negative exchange-current density, electrolyte diffusivity) from synthetic low-SOC GITT voltage at the §2.7 protocol, plus a profile likelihood over the diffusivity. Dry-run of the identification machinery on synthetic data; no real data involved.

recovery.rule: |z| <= 3 against the predicted SE and multi-start estimate spread ratio <= 1.05, for every parameter
recovery.unconstrained_note: Parameters touching a null direction of the truth FIM cannot be constrained by this dataset; their standard error is reported as inf and they are never counted as recovered.

multi_start_fits.message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

profile_likelihood.rule: closed iff the minimum is interior and the cost exceeds the minimum by 3.841 on both sides of the declared grid

limitations: SYNTHETIC ONLY: the fitted data are model-generated with declared noise, not measured.
Recovery at one declared truth point; it does not explore the parameter space or prove global identifiability.
Only three parameters are free; function-valued parameters are perturbed by a constant multiplier (their functional form is assumed known).
GITT pulse overpotential mixes transport with ohmic and kinetic contributions; this is not a pure solid-diffusion estimator.

The profile likelihood is coarse (declared grid) and local: it bounds the parameter under this protocol and noise only. Crossings are linearly interpolated between grid points, so a convex profile's interval is slightly underestimated; refine the grid before quoting tight bounds.
No calibration objective, registry record or dossier decision was changed.
scientific_note: Synthetic dry-run of the identification machinery only. A successful recovery does not prove identifiability on real data (rule 7) and is not experimental validation (rule 8). The dossier action for this parameter remains MEASURE; gates 2/3 of docs/D_NEG_ACTION_DECISION.md must be re-run on a real dataset before any decision change (rule 10).
